about.description: Swarm is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: Swarm Markets GmbH (Germany), BaFin-regulated tokenization platform and decentralized regulated exchange. Launched 2017, headquartered in Berlin. Issues tokenized stocks, ETFs, and treasuries with full MiFID II compliance and German securities regulator oversight. SMT governance token.

fees.revenueNotes: Swarm captures AMM trading fees on its on-chain venue and primary-market spreads on tokenized issuances. SMT stakers receive a share of platform fees. Closely held — exact basis points not publicly disclosed.
